value.rationale: The smallest indecomposable non-solvable five-dimensional Lie algebra, the special-affine algebra A_{5,40}, is a canonical perfect radical extension. The exact prescribed-target word-map invariant distinguishes the radical target layer and gives uniform fibers on the entire nonzero semisimple-projection stratum, a structural fact not deducible from the two ambient 6D enumerations. The result supplies exact commutator probability and surjectivity across all odd finite fields, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
